notes: The initial origin/main review included unrelated trial files after the ref moved. The final review uses pinned ecdfb486..HEAD.
The broad census used generated source and a preset fixture as authored source. The final strict census checks the three changed TypeScript files.
The forced control passes before and after; no red failure is claimed for unchanged behavior.
Core has no resource graceful-close-start hook and its extension close hook is root-only. The shipped startRequests hook binds native root and createSession handles.
Shared-bank merge and landing calibration belong to the lead. No full mutation lane was requested.
No stash, push, trial-store access, container command, or Core change. All long jobs finish before the final report.
